structured.answer: The page says to hold it in an account at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) in the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, I'd end with about 179,889 ₪ in today's money. That assumes 2% inflation a year and the page's 7% yearly return, on 135,000 ₪ put in.

stuck.why: I typed 750 but I think the slider read 800, so I wasn't sure which one the page used
It opens with English letters (S&P 500, MSCI) on a dark background, which felt like it wasn't for me
